dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: Every reasoning span across the entire pattern lifecycle flow successfully conformed to its designated JSON schema without validation failures. Strict adherence to contracts was maintained across rule loading, dual-pattern extraction, proposal generation, scope classification, promotion workflow, and fan-out reference architecture generation.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The trace showcases a rigorous causal progression starting with rule context ingestion and pattern extraction, synthesized into pattern proposals, systematically classified by scope, evaluated through promotion governance, and materialized into individual reference architecture artifacts.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: Architectural tensions and boundary conditions are explicitly managed through the dedicated pattern-scope-classifier and pattern-promotion-workflow stages, effectively arbitrating pattern reusability, boundaries, and governance constraints prior to reference architecture synthesis.
